$comment: Paired flag A/B for Phases 2+3 of the CP-side compliance fix (slack-budget respect).

Phase 2 (enable_cp_slack_reserve_debit + feedback target shift, unflagged): the SlackBudgetMonitor's feedback deadband topped out exactly at the compliance claim's threshold B*1.05, and the CP kernel's input cap saw the nominal budget with no debit for the measured over-draw, so CP gas draw settled 2-16% over budget (eval_full_v2_20260711: 85% of slack fails, all marginal). The monitor now targets B*(1-0.05) and publishes a peak-hold/decay reserve that HolonSummaryRole debits from the CP-facing slack budget.

Phase 3 (enable_coalition_delivered_supply + xs-coalition actuatability gate): coalition acceptance pools credited generators at RATED capacity and slacks without the reserve debit; the resulting fractions are held as an L2 priority floor that clamps slack-budget override sheds UP for the TTL, structurally disarming budget enforcement (elec child-118 overdraw, median 1.68x, coalition arms only).
Arms: slack_gas experiment isolates Phase 2 on the marginal-gas population (slack_budget_pct=0.15 = the 70%-fail regime); coalition_elec isolates Phase 3 under enable_holon_coalition=true.

Judge on: claims__slack_budget_compliance__passed + per_slack steady_peak/threshold (gas child-287, elec child-118), outcomes__cp_generation n_active/gas_mw (CP wake-up must survive the debit), PWSF, temperature n_violations (must stay at the Phase-1-fixed level).
name: ab_cp_slack_debit
